name: cz.vitexsoftware/mcp-server-email
description: MCP server for reading and sending e-mail over IMAP/SMTP.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_EMAIL_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: E-mail address of the mailbox (single-account environment mode).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Mailbox password, used for IMAP and SMTP unless overridden below.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_IMAP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: IMAP server host name.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_IMAP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: IMAP server port.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_IMAP_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Use implicit TLS for IMAP.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_IMAP_START_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Use STARTTLS for IMAP.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_IMAP_VERIFY_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Verify the IMAP server certificate.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_IMAP_USER_NAME
environmentVariables.description: IMAP login if different from USER_NAME.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_IMAP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: IMAP password if different from PASSWORD.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_SMTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: SMTP server host name. Leave empty for a read-only mailbox: sending is enabled only when this is set.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_SMTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: SMTP server port.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_SMTP_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Use implicit TLS for SMTP.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_SMTP_START_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Use STARTTLS for SMTP.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_SMTP_VERIFY_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Verify the SMTP server certificate.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_SMTP_USER_NAME
environmentVariables.description: SMTP login if different from USER_NAME.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_SMTP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: SMTP password if different from PASSWORD.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_USER_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Login name; defaults to the e-mail address.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_FULL_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Display name used in the From header; defaults to the part before @.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_ACCOUNT_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Account name shown to MCP clients.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_SAVE_TO_SENT
environmentVariables.description: Save a copy of sent messages to the Sent folder.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_SENT_FOLDER_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Sent folder name; auto-detected when empty.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated recipient patterns the server may send to; sending is blocked for others.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_ALLOWED_SENDERS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated sender patterns the server may read messages from.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_ENABLE_ATTACHMENT_DOWNLOAD
environmentVariables.description: Allow downloading attachments to disk.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_ENABLE_ATTACHMENT_CONTENT
environmentVariables.description: Allow returning attachment content to the client.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_REPORT_BLOCKED_MUTATIONS
environmentVariables.description: Report blocked send/modify attempts instead of failing silently.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_CONFIG_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path of the TOML configuration / managed account catalog bootstrap.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_CREDENTIAL_STORAGE
environmentVariables.description: Where account passwords are stored.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity.
